name: AWS CloudTrail
description: The Sumo Logic App for AWS CloudTrail helps you monitor your AWS deployments, with predefined dashboards that present user and administrator activity, network and security information, CloudTrail console logins, and information about your S3 buckets and public objects.

children.name: AWS CloudTrail - Console Logins
children.description: See information about CloudTrail console logins, including location of users, login events by user, logins from multiple IP address, logins from outside the US, and logins without multi-factor authentication.

panels.name: Geo Location of All Users
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail 
| json "sourceIPAddress"
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName nodrop
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.principalId" as principal_id nodrop
| parse regex field = principal_id ":(?<user_principal>.+)" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_principal, user_name) as user 
| parse "\"responseElements\":{\"ConsoleLogin\":\"*\"}" as loginResult nodrop
| parse "\"MFAUsed\":\"*\"" as mfaUsed nodrop
| where eventName="ConsoleLogin"
| count by sourceIPAddress
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = sourceIPAddress
| where !isNull(latitude)
| sum(_count) as _count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort by _count

panels.name: Login Events By User
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* "ConsoleLogin"
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as eventName nodrop
| where eventName="ConsoleLogin"
| parse "\"sourceIPAddress\":\"*\"" as sourceIPAddress nodrop
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.principalId" as principal_id nodrop
| parse regex field = principal_id ":(?<user_principal>.+)" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_principal, user_name) as user 
| json field=_raw "responseElements.ConsoleLogin" as loginResult nodrop
| parse "\"MFAUsed\":\"*\"" as mfaUsed nodrop
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, user
| transpose row _timeslice column  user

panels.name: Logins from Multiple IP

| parse "\"sourceIPAddress\":\"*\"" as sourceIPAddress nodrop
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop

children.name: AWS CloudTrail - Network and Security
children.description: See information about network and security events, authorization failures, security group and network ACL changes, and short lived critical operations.

panels.name: Authorization Failures from All Countries
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* "\"errorCode\":\"AccessDenied\""
| json "sourceIPAddress"
| json "errorCode"
| where errorCode="AccessDenied"
| count by sourceIPAddress
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = sourceIPAddress
| where !isNull(latitude)
| sum(_count) as _count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort by _count

panels.name: Network and Security Events Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* 
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name
| parse regex field=event_name "^(?<event_type>[A-Z][a-z]+?)[A-Z]"
| where (event_Name matches "*Security*" OR event_name matches "*Network*") AND !(event_type in ("Get","Describe","List"))
| timeslice 1h 
| count _timeslice,event_name
| transpose row _timeslice column event_name

panels.name: Authorization Failures Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* "\"errorCode\":\"AccessDenied\""
| json "errorCode"
| where errorCode="AccessDenied"
| timeslice 1h
| count as count _timeslice

panels.name: Network ACL with All Allowed Ingress/Egress
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (CreateNetworkAclEntry or AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress) 65535
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.principalId" as principal_id nodrop
| parse regex field = principal_id ":(?<user_principal>.+)" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_principal, user_name) as user 
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name
| parse "\"portRange\":{\"from\":*,\"to\":*}" as from_port,to_port nodrop 
| parse "\"fromPort\":*,\"toPort\":*," as from_Port,to_Port  
| where from_port="0" and to_port="65535" 
| where event_name in ("CreateNetworkAclEntry","AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress")
| parse "\"egress\":*," as egress nodrop 
| parse regex field=event_name "AuthorizeSecurityGroup(?<direction>[A-Za-z]+)" 
| parse "\"cidrBlock\":\"*\"" as cidr_block nodrop 
| parse "\"cidrIp\":\"*\"" as cidr_block 
| if(egress="false" OR direction="Ingress","inbound","outbound") as direction
| parse "\"ruleAction\":\"*\"" as action nodrop 
| if(event_name="AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress","allow",action) as action
| where action="allow"
| timeslice 1m 
| count as count by _timeslice,user,event_Name,cidr_block,direction,from_port,to_port
| fields -count 
| sort _timeslice 
| limit 10

panels.name: Created and Deleted Network and Security Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (*Security* OR *Network*) 
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.principalId" as principal_id nodrop
| parse regex field = principal_id ":(?<user_principal>.+)" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_principal, user_name) as user 
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event
| parse regex field=event "^(?<event_type>[A-Z][a-z]+?)[A-Z]"
| where (event matches "*Security*" OR event matches "*Network*") and event_type in ("Create","Delete") 
| count by event 
| sort _count

panels.name: Short Lived Critical Operations
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail* (putuserpolicy or deleteuserpolicy or createuser or deleteuser or creategroup or deletegroup) 
| parse "\"userName\":\"*\"" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "userIdentity.principalId" as principal_id nodrop
| parse regex field = principal_id ":(?<user_principal>.+)" nodrop
| if (user_name="", user_principal, user_name) as src_user 
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name
| parse "awsRegion\":\"*\"" as aws_Region 
| where event_Name in ("PutUserPolicy","DeleteUserPolicy","CreateUser","DeleteUser","CreateGroup","DeleteGroup") 
| parse regex field=event_name "^(?<event_type>[A-Z][a-z]+?)(?<resource_type>[A-Z][A-Za-z]+)"
| if(event_Name in ("PutUserPolicy","DeleteUserPolicy"),"Short-lived User Policy Assignment","Other") as event_description 
| if(event_Name in ("CreateUser","DeleteUser"),"Short-lived User Creation and Deletion",event_description) as event_description 
| if(event_Name in ("CreateGroup","DeleteGroup"),"Short-lived Group Creation and Deletion",event_description) as event_description 
| parse regex "\"requestParameters\":[\s\S]+?\"userName\":\"(?<dest_user>[^\"]+?)\"" nodrop 
| parse "\"policyName\":\"*\"" as resource_name nodrop
| parse "\"groupName\":\"*\"" as resource_name nodrop 
| if(event_type in ("Create","Put"),_messageTime,0) as start_messagetime
| if(event_type in ("Delete"),_messageTime,0) as end_messagetime
| sum(start_messagetime) as start_messagetime,sum(end_messagetime) as end_messagetime by src_user,dest_user,aws_region,event_description,resource_name 
| where start_messagetime !=0 AND end_messagetime !=0 AND ((end_messagetime-start_messagetime)< 600000)
| fields -start_messagetime,end_messagetime

children.name: AWS CloudTrail - Operations
children.description: See information about operations activity in your AWS account, including action events, requested AWS services, events by AWS region, created and deleted resources, and elastic IP address operations.

| where event_type not in ("Get","Describe","List")
| count by event_name 
| sort by _count
